verdict.rationale: Relay's first-party docs cover all three pillars in one platform: banking (up to 20 checking accounts, deposits, wires, savings), spend (Visa debit and credit cards with limits, roles, receipt capture, accounting sync), and bill pay (bill upload, multi-step approvals, vendor payments), plus invoicing that needs 'no separate tool'. Community reviews independently confirm the banking and account side, but corroboration of the spend and bill-pay modules is thin. One user notes external payments still have to be executed manually. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of bill pay and spend management, and evidence of migration or consolidation onboarding from existing point tools.
